# Gramlot Python Server 0.3.19

- Add the opt-in Uvicorn WebSocket channel for PageStore synchronization, RPC and same-owner publications.
- Multiplex the complete Gramlot window family through the primary socket and reject individual publication errors without closing the channel.
- Preserve PageStore classes while staging gallery pages, and expose the Uvicorn gallery --websocket option.
- Keep the current shared HTTP adapter, collection discovery and resource handling.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.19. Other adapters retain their HTTP behavior; the WebSocket integration is currently Uvicorn-specific.
